text: Let's keep Cloud cosy! Draw a black shelter. Catch your line on the fixed posts or rocks. Then let the bees fly.
Try a roof that reaches across both posts. Rest your line on the map, so it doesn't slip away.
Here come the bees! Let's see if your shelter holds.
A little bee found a gap. That's okay! Let's draw another shelter.
Cloud is safe and cosy! Your drawing held. Great helping!
